statement: Bristol Myers Squibb is deploying eight DGX Vera Rubin NVL72 systems as a second SuperPOD, a Rubin-generation enterprise design win in life sciences.
why: A named enterprise commits to Rubin-generation DGX infrastructure, signaling forward demand for next-gen NVIDIA GPUs.

impact.mechanism: Enterprise adoption of DGX Vera Rubin drives demand for Rubin GPUs and AI-factory buildout.

evidence.excerpt: eight DGX Vera Rubin NVL72 systems

confidence.basis: Primary NVIDIA announcement of a named customer deployment.

dispersion: conflicting same-key reports: statement/trend changed (trend rising -> rising); sources: NVIDIA Blog, NVIDIA Newsroom
